name: PGM on Carbon Support
description: Precious group metal (Pt, Pd, Ru) deposited on activated carbon from solution in a stirred slurry, recovered by filtration, then vacuum dried. Slurry-phase excess-solution practice: carbon supports are difficult to wet uniformly, which is the textbook case for working in excess solution rather than at incipient wetness.
source: Jimenez et al., Industrial Catalyst Impregnation: Modern Equipment, Techniques, and Scaling Challenges, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 65, 12447 (2026)
route_note: Description previously said incipient wetness while the step list slurries and filters. The steps carry the cost and match excess-solution practice on carbon (slurry, filtration, mother-liquor handling), so the words were corrected to match the steps, not the steps to the words.
